## Finding: Feb 2026 vs Jan 2026 revenue drop (sales.revenue_inr)

Question: "Why was February 2026 revenue lower than January 2026?"

- Jan 2026 revenue ≈ ₹529.8M; Feb 2026 ≈ ₹460.7M (−₹69.1M, −13.0%).
- Every channel (D2C, PLATFORM, QCOMM, OFFLINE, INTERNATIONAL, CAFE) fell by the same ~13%. Revenue per unit (~₹585) and discount rates were flat.
- The daily revenue pattern has two levels: ~₹11.5M on normal weekdays and ~₹23M on "high" days. High days are Sat/Sun plus an elevated month-end window (Jan 23–Feb 1, Feb 24–28).
- Jan had 15 high days and 16 normal days. Feb had 12 high days and 16 normal days. The whole drop equals 3 fewer high-volume days (3 × ~₹23M). Per-day rates did not change.
- Takeaway: month-over-month revenue comparisons in this warehouse are driven by calendar mix (day count, weekend count, month-end window length). Normalize per day / per day-type before calling it a performance change.

Source: sl_query on sales source, by month × channel and by day, Jan–Feb 2026.
